commands.name: events.create
commands.description: Add an event to the NakliOS Calendar. For a relative day ("next Friday") call get_time first.

start.description: Local start, e.g. "2026-11-02T15:00", or "2026-11-02" for all day

commands.name: events.list
commands.description: Read what is on the NakliOS Calendar for a day or a few days, e.g. "what is on today", "am I free tomorrow".

date.description: Leave this out for today. Otherwise the first day as "YYYY-MM-DD"; call get_time first for "tomorrow" or a weekday

commands.name: events.update
commands.description: Change an event in the Calendar app by its title, e.g. "move the dentist to 4 pm tomorrow".

commands.name: events.delete
commands.description: Delete an event in the Calendar app by its title, e.g. "cancel the dentist". A repeating event goes with its whole series.

parity.import: person: picks a file; callers send one through Files
parity.import-file: person: picks a file; callers send one through Files
parity.event-timezone: person: the time zone of one event stays in the event editor
parity.event-repeat: person: repeat rules stay in the event editor
parity.event-until: person: repeat rules stay in the event editor
parity.event-description: person: long descriptions stay in the event editor
